summary: A partial fingerprint recovered from the zip tie matches Marcus Reed. The cut end shows a single clean pass consistent with a pocketknife, not a snap or tear — this was deliberately cut, not broken in a struggle.
details: Latent print analysis recovered a partial thumbprint from the underside of the zip tie, with 11 identifiable ridge characteristics — sufficient for a provisional match. Cross-referencing against the CID database returned a match to Marcus Reed, on file from an unrelated civil complaint filed last year. Microscopic examination of the cut end shows a smooth, single-pass separation consistent with a small folding blade, ruling out accidental snapping. Combined with the torn pawn ticket recovered at the scene, this places Reed at the location and indicates the restraint was prepared rather than improvised in the moment.
recommendations: Bring Marcus Reed in for questioning regarding his whereabouts last night.
Confirm the timeline against the Back Alley Camera footage.
